_comment: Companion-app OTA manifest. The installed app fetches this from raw.githubusercontent.com (main) on demand, compares versionCode, and offers to download+install the apk when this is newer. Bump BOTH fields on every app release and upload the matching apk as the release asset named below. The app track is versioned INDEPENDENTLY of the Nexus Q image releases.
notes: Now Playing is a card: cover, title, artist and album, a position bar, and UP NEXT with what follows. AirPlay is controlled like Spotify — the buttons act on it and the state follows. Fixes: logging in to Spotify twice, a title left on screen after the music ended, a play button with nothing to play, and the queue arriving a track late. Needs device nexusq-control r44 + nexusqd r18 for the AirPlay half.
